title: Engsel Cetak 3D yang Bisa Membaca Gerakan
eventDescription: X-Hinges preprint submitted10Sep2026; MIT public feature22Oct2026.
relevance: Recent2026 multi-material printable motion sensing with concrete interactive-object demonstrations.
limit: Ilustrasi konsep • respons sensor, bukan kesadaran.
accuracyNote: Embedded sensing uses two conductive materials with distinct conductivities; examples include a pinch-dimmable lamp and motion-capture glove. Objects are not conscious.

title: Drone Merencanakan Jalur di Antara Penghalang Bergerak
eventDescription: MIT report7Oct2026 of SANDO research appearing in IEEE Transactions on Robotics; exact paper-first-publication date not independently resolved.
relevance: Current2026 trajectory-planning research addressing dynamic, previously unmapped spaces.
limit: Ilustrasi konsep • jaminan berlaku dalam asumsi model.
accuracyNote: Safety guarantee is mathematical under stated assumptions, including a valid maximum speed bound for obstacles; not an unconditional guarantee for any drone or real-world failure mode. SANDO is a planner, not a claim of an AI model.

title: Data Satelit Mampir ke Satelit Lain
eventDescription: Two NASA-funded commercial relay demonstrations launched20Oct2026; source updated21Oct. Tests described as forthcoming over coming weeks.
relevance: A launch this month for new commercial space-relay demonstrations, distinct from the older existence of relay communications.
limit: Ilustrasi orbit • peluncuran bukan hasil akhir pengujian.
accuracyNote: Viasat and SES demonstrations launched; article describes planned testing and autonomous routing, not verified completed results. Orbits and network geometry are schematic and not to scale; no cross-provider handover claim.
titles:

mampir ke satelit lain.

title: Robot Renang Bertenaga Sel Otot Hidup
eventDescription: News and accompanying Advanced Functional Materials paper described as appearing29Sep2026. Predecessor muscle architecture was earlier work; swimming demonstration is the2026 result.
relevance: New2026 biohybrid swimming demonstration, different from prior mechanical insect microrobot story.
limit: Sel hidup dalam eksperimen • gerak ilustratif.
accuracyNote: Living engineered muscle cells respond to light; thin gel fins supply locomotion. Demonstrated a simple water maze and peak about4 body lengths/minute. Not a deployed medical device, autonomous field swimmer or robot powered by sunlight alone.
closing:
Robot lunak
bisa ke mana lagi?
caption: Robot biohibrida MIT ini memakai kontraksi sel otot pada sirip gel tipis. Cahaya menjadi pemicu kendali, dan demonstrasinya berlangsung di labirin air sederhana. Belum menjadi perangkat lapangan atau medis. #Biohibrida #Robotika
